# Shalini Choudhary — Senior SEO Manager & Growth Marketer

Senior SEO and growth marketing professional with 8+ years across GroupM, Ogilvy, JLL, and Global University Systems. Core expertise in technical SEO, international SEO (hreflang), GEO/AI Overviews, demand generation, and marketing analytics (GA4). Currently based in the UK, completing an MSc in Marketing Management at the University of Leeds.
